steps.status: bounded semantic SRL revision complete; general semantic reliability remains open

items.text: Specify semantic requirements for 25 real diagnostic claims and 21 controls; flag uncertain readings separately
Implement a common JSON logical form and deterministic compiler, including recursive source content, shared referents, predicate senses and source-aligned temporal fields
Expose simple noun-phrase modifiers and keep opaque phrases explicitly marked
Compare trained SRL, pretrained AMR and direct/SRL-assisted frozen logical-form generation on the fixed development inputs
Freeze before checking new source videos; preserve the first 20-source results, fix structural bugs, and evaluate on ten additional disjoint sources
Review accepted programs as well as refusals; keep executability, diagnostic checks and meaning judgments separate
Fix remaining criticism/reporting scope and nominal media descriptions; require complete original-claim coverage before automatic acceptance
Define context requirements for bare names, labels, omitted subjects and underspecified measurements
Complete wider modifier/reference coverage and rerun a frozen source-disjoint evaluation before selecting a default parser
Freeze all 2,375 original texts; run the prior SRL/AMR compiler over every claim and retain every rejection reason
Parse all original claims with the larger frozen text model; add scoped proposition arguments, group quantities, measurements, noun-phrase relations and explicit context requirements
Run the revised compiler on all 2,375 claims; validate generated programs and review accepted outputs and refusals separately
Publish per-claim outputs, full-corpus statistics and semantic failure examples; do not equate compilation with correctness
Run one SRL/dependency clause-graph compiler on all 2,375 original inputs without candidate selection
Compare concise token-referenced LLM edits with and without AMR on the same 48 claims; review the same 24 random cases
Complete the bounded nominal source/prediction-scope changes and inspect remaining event-nominal identity errors
Implement structured a/an copular/location complements and selected explicit/lexically licensed event controllers; retain broader limitations

steps.note: srl_semantics_20261029: prior SRL 1,997/2,375 compiled; revised 2,042 (1,870 claims and 172 nominal descriptions). Development 24 faithful: 7 to 13; fresh 20: 7 to 8, incorrect 4 to 2. Same-assistant review, no independent gold or corpus accuracy estimate. Source/identity/controller rules improved selected cases; existing SRL role errors, event-nominal identity and duration types remain open. No LLM calls or rewriting.

steps.title: Complete the bounded semantic compilation revision

items.text: Write 24 reference readings and reserve 20 fresh IDs before changes — separate intended meaning from program validity
Fix selected source/prediction scope and modifier attachment — preserve evidence context
Fix a/an predicational identity and structured spatial complements — share entity references
Complete selected embedded subjects with explicit links or lexical control classes — avoid a universal subject assumption
Freeze and rerun all 2,375 inputs, review fresh cases and test reference compilation — measure acceptance and meaning separately

steps.note: Completed bounded work does not imply every claim now compiles correctly. All 44 paired reviews and all per-claim outputs are in the new report.

steps.title: Keep meaning and executability checks separate

steps.note: Reference-to-logic and SRL-to-graph checks are separate. Native DeepProbLog passes two constructed checks; image/damage times out after 30 seconds including startup. Whole-corpus inference and training performance are unmeasured. Fresh IDs are within-corpus, not source-disjoint gold.

intro: Current priority: original-claim compilation. The bounded semantic SRL revision is complete: 2,042/2,375 inputs compile, but accepted meaning errors remain. Fresh 20-case review has 8 faithful, 5 partial, 2 incorrect and 5 refused outputs. Keep media verification and relation training deferred.
